# meilisearch Provider

Manages Meilisearch server APIs. Requires Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.14.0"

  required_providers {
    meilisearch = {
      source = "hans-m-song/meilisearch"
    }
  }
}

provider "meilisearch" {
  host              = "http://localhost:7700"
  api_key           = "T35T-M45T3R-K3Y"
  operation_timeout = "5m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Meilisearch API key with permissions for the managed operations. May also be provided via MEILISEARCH_API_KEY.
- `host` (String) HTTP(S) URL of the Meilisearch server, without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment. May also be provided via MEILISEARCH_HOST.
- `operation_timeout` (String) Maximum duration of an API operation, including asynchronous task completion, as a positive Go duration (for example, 5m or 30s). Defaults to 5m.
